sar.narrative: The bank’s monitoring system identified customer C13487 using card C13487‑K1 for a single online purchase of $74.96 (transaction 3478561) on 22 November 2016 at 16:11:00. The transaction was processed through the bank’s online channel and billed to region 191.0. The purchase was made from a Samsung SM‑G935F device (Build/NRD90M, Android 7.0, Chrome 62.0) that had never been seen on any of the bank’s accounts and was routed through an anonymous proxy IP address. The same device profile has been linked to confirmed fraudulent activity in prior cases CC‑2971, CC‑3035, CC‑2985 and CC‑2649, each involving different cards but the identical SM‑G935F fingerprint and proxy usage. No other cards or device profiles are currently connected to this transaction. The convergence of a previously unseen device, the use of an anonymous proxy, and the repeat appearance of this exact fingerprint in multiple confirmed fraud cases constitute the specific evidence that makes this activity suspicious. The total amount in question is $74.96.
